title: Helicopter freezes mid-air while trying to intercept a 'tic-tac'
place_text: About 7 km northwest (340 degrees) of the Skywatcher site

tellings.quote: Our helicopter took off, and approximately he is half a mile away stopped moving.

plain: Skywatcher, a startup that says it can call up UFOs, says that in 2025 it sent a helicopter after a "tic-tac", a white oval object shaped like the mint, about 7 kilometres northwest of its site. A team member says that about half a mile away, the object "stopped moving" and froze in mid-air as the helicopter came near. He tells it as something the team saw, and if true it would mean the object reacted to being chased.
